text:
Olivia: Heads-up: planning a config-only deploy at 12:10 PT — thin-window changes: routing weight floor + batching cap + request_timeout tweak. No model binaries. TL;DR: `routing.policy.weight_floor=0.02`, `batching.max_batch=8`, `request_timeout_ms=1800`. Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> full if green.

Sam: +1. can we move to 12:10? lunch overlap at 11:15 looks bad.

Maya: +1 from infra. Will add SLO watches. Can you paste the roll-plan and short rollback criteria?

Olivia: Roll plan: deploy via deploybot (job id pending), observe p95 latency, error rate (5xx), and kvcache miss rate. Rollback if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 increases > 20% over baseline for 5m. Roll-window: 45m total.

Zach: Noted. Which tenant/model are we gating? Any per-tenant pins needed?

Olivia: Start canary on general routing (5% global). We'll pin `search-model` to existing routing for affected tenants if we see tail issues. No model version change.

deploybot: [job queued] deploybot has scheduled job 2026-04-CONFIG-8921 for 12:10 PT. Steps: validate config -> apply canary 5% -> wait 15m -> promote 50% -> wait 10m -> promote to 100%. Trigger: Olivia

Liam: Quick check — can you paste the config snippet we'll roll?

Olivia: ```
# config roll: 2026-04-12/config-only
routing:
  policy:
    weight_floor: 0.02
batching:
  max_batch: 8
  batch_timeout_ms: 25
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 1800
```

Maya: Adding SLO watches: p95_latency_alert: > baseline*1.2 for 5m, error_rate_alert: > 0.5% for 3m. Dashboard: https://obs/redwood/d/abcd

deploybot: Canary apply started at 12:10 PT -> canary id=cfg-8921-canary-1 -> target=5%

deploybot: Canary metrics snapshot (t+7m): p95 +12ms, 5xx 0.22% -> within thresholds

Olivia: Keep an eye on kvcache pressure — earlier thin-window changes bumped tail for search-model.

oncall-bot: alert: tenant-search-model kvcache_evictions up 3x over baseline (12:17 PT) — rate increase correlates with canary nodes

Zach: seeing p99 spikes for search-model in canary nodes, p99 +180ms. p95 okay. Suggest hold canary and reduce batching.max_batch to 6 for canary.

Sam: Agree. Hold promote. Can we patch config in-place for the canary only?

deploybot: Pausing promote. apply patch to canary: set `batching.max_batch=6` for canary group -> reapplying...

deploybot: Canary metrics (t+18m after patch): p99 back to baseline, kvcache_evictions stabilizing, 5xx 0.24%. Good.

Maya: Looks stable for last 6m. I'd extend canary to 25m total before 50% promote given the tail history.

Olivia: Extending canary to 25m. If no regressions, promote to 50% and shorten final gate to 5m.

deploybot: Canary extended. New schedule: 5% for 25m -> 50% for 10m -> full.

Liam: Can someone draft the release note blurb?

Olivia: Release note (short): "Config-only: routing weight floor introduced to reduce tiny-route thrash; batching max reduced for select workloads to improve tail latency; request timeout raised to 1800ms (smoother retries). Canaryed and adjusted batching for search-model to avoid kv pressure."

Sam: ack.

Zach: tagging infra: @maya for postmortem if we see followups.

deploybot: Promote to 50% at 12:45 PT -> metrics steady. Promote to 100% at 12:55 PT -> complete.

deploybot: Job 2026-04-CONFIG-8921 completed at 12:56 PT.

Olivia: Thanks all. I'll push the release note to the release channel and update the changelog. If we get any customer reports, we'll open a follow-up and consider a targeted pin.

Maya: Good job. I'll keep alerts on for the next 24h and add a brief check-in tomorrow morning.

Sam: :thumbsup:

Zach: :+1:

Liam: closing loop — no rollback needed. Filing a tiny eval-run against search-model prompt set to confirm quality.
